passive.name: Cell Division
passive.text: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets. Each bloblet has a percentage of Zac's maximum Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. This ability has a 5 minute cooldown.

spells.name: Stretching Strikes
spells.text: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

spells.name: Unstable Matter
spells.text: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.

spells.name: Elastic Slingshot
spells.text: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

spells.name: Let's Bounce!
spells.text: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.

damage.value: Zac deals burst magic damage with Unstable Matter, which hits nearby enemies for a percentage of their maximum Health.

archetype.value: Zac is a tank jungler who engages, applies crowd control, and deals damage.

winCondition.value: Zac wins extended team fights through crowd control and strong healing.

spikes.why: Zac can launch himself forward more often as its cooldown falls from 21 to 9 seconds.

bait.why: Zac cannot rely on Cell Division’s revival while its five-minute cooldown is running.
Zac cannot launch himself forward with Elastic Slingshot again until its cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Zac cannot trigger Stretching Strikes’ throw by attacking the enemy he grabbed instead of a different enemy.
